# JSON to Excel Converter Project

This is a React TypeScript application built with Next.js that converts JSON data to Excel files.

## Features
- JSON input validation and parsing
- Configurable flattening options (delimiter, max depth)
- Array handling modes (explode, join, first)
- Column reordering via drag & drop
- Export to XLSX and CSV formats
- Copy to clipboard functionality
- File upload and URL fetching support
- Real-time preview with editable cells

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- xlsx library for Excel export
- React hooks for state management

## Development
- Use `npm run dev` to start development server
- Build with `npm run build`
- Export static files with `npm run export`
